quantiles: Nearest rank, no interpolation. Each metric reports its own sample size; failed initialization has no composed map. Cold is process-first, not OS-cache-cold. Warm timings include concurrent workers; no reference-machine certification.

baseGeneratorRetries.method: Zero-based successful base-city attempt index equals preceding rejected jitter attempts. Composed initialization failures use separately retained deterministic base-generation replays, never replacement campaign seeds.
